Data extraction: PO gettext message pairs with msgid as key and msgstr as value

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"msgid "Hello"
msgstr "Hallo"
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"data_extraction":true,"language":"po"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config);
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
